claude.scope: Public/generic design and code only; no private repository/results transfer. Claude authored implementation and paired statistics, not a review of private measured outcomes.

limitations: Three paired seeds, two control checkpoints, same 50 source cases; no frozen significance or time-to-target threshold.
No independent-data reduction or configuration-disjoint evaluation; calibration and normalization access extend beyond optimizer window prefixes.
Logged preclip norms are 61 samples per run, not every-update clipping frequency or a gradient-variance trajectory.
Full source HDF5 data were not rehashed during the final integrity audit; declared identities retained.
